question: Can scheduling-only M/N geometry changes retain the natural M1/M2/M4 W8A16 arithmetic class while removing the source-M4 strategy's large-M latency penalty?

r140_trigger.root_cause_hypothesis: R139 froze source-M32 arithmetic; natural controls show M1, M2, and M4 share one row class while M16/M32 share another.

frozen_anchor.strategy: gemm qH[SH] T@16N@16N 16 4 1 0 aS16#16,0{cc}+S16,16@32{cc} aB64x2{cc}+S64,64@72{cc} aB#16,0{cc/ub} wg 8x1x8 ikr ki64 sys af k128 vav di dm sr bf li nmk sb128 np bm262144 bn65536 bk16777216
frozen_anchor.prior_evidence: R123 proved this strategy invariant over all registered M values on both attention shapes; natural controls put M1/M2/M4 in one row class. R141 rechecks natural M1 equality directly on every screened shape.

candidates.m16_n16_wg4x1x8: Start from the natural M16 16x16 strategy and change only wgK from 2 to 8.
candidates.m16_n16_wg4x2x8: The preceding candidate with two-way N scheduling.
candidates.m32_n32_wg4x1x8: Start from the validated R136 32x32 fixed-K geometry, replace its two-way local-K split with the anchor's eight-way split, and reduce N scheduling to one.
candidates.m32_n32_wg2x2x8: The same 32x32 geometry with balanced two-way M/N scheduling and the anchor's eight-way local-K split.

screen.order: For each shape, capture natural M1 and the forced source-M4 anchor first; then run candidates in the listed order, each in a fresh process. Invalid strategy parses are recorded failures and do not authorize edits or substitution.
screen.identity: Every candidate output at every M must be bitwise equal to its shape's forced source-M4 output and natural M1 row; repeat M128, a seeded M128 permutation, and 168-to-200 padding must also be exact.
screen.timing: Ten warmups, five samples of 100 synchronized calls at M2, M64, M128, M168, and M256. Report candidate/source-M4 and candidate/natural ratios.
screen.stability: No timed sample max/min ratio may exceed 1.15.

gates.decode_model: Using the frozen call counts, a passing candidate or a two-candidate M-threshold composition must model <=1.03x natural at M2, M64, and M128.
gates.prefill: M168 and M256 must each model <=2.0x natural.
gates.composition: A threshold composition is allowed only when both strategies independently produce the identical source-M4 digest on both sides of the boundary.
gates.on_pass: Expand only the fastest passing strategy or exact threshold composition to all six production shapes, then build a narrow source selector and rerun endpoint identity before concurrency.
gates.on_failure: Close oneDNN catalog geometry for natural-M1 anchoring and implement a purpose-built fixed-reduction W8A16 kernel whose reduction order is explicitly matched to natural M1.

abort_conditions: any current-boot Xe fault, CAT error, reset, coredump, device loss, timeout, or hung stage visible to the available health interfaces
either B70 is not normal before or after a case
any unregistered strategy edit, candidate substitution, or server launch
